description:
Scott's Mineral Box Industries
Vintage Rocks and Minerals Specimen Collection Set
24 Labeled Specimens with Display Box
A classic mid-century educational geology collection produced by Scott's Mineral Box Industries of Custer, South Dakota. Dating to the 1950s to 1960s, these boxed study sets were distributed to rockhounds, students, and tourists visiting the Black Hills. Each natural geological specimen is mounted and identified on a printed compartmentalized tray, illustrating key ore, mineral, and rock classifications from North American deposits.
Includes 24 individually labeled specimens including Gold Ore, Copper Ore, Rose Quartz, Muscovite, Uranium Ore, and Petrified Wood
Accompanied by an additional natural clear quartz crystal point
Housed in the original faux-tooled leatherette textured cardboard box with matching lid
Measures approximately 8.6 inches long by 5.6 inches wide by 1 inch deep
Condition:
Box lid and base remain structurally sound with light corner and edge wear consistent with age. Printed tray is clean and legible with all 24 labeled specimens intact and firmly attached. Loose quartz crystal point is complete with natural terminations and surface inclusions.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.
Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.
For qualifying pick-up orders, pickup is available by appointment only.
Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

description:
Title
: Mineral Rock & Crystal Specimen Collection Bundle
Condition
: Used
Department
: Collectibles & Art
Description
: Enhance your collection or decor with this distinctive mineral rock and crystal specimen bundle. This set includes multiple raw mineral rock pieces, several crystalline selenite sticks in sealed packaging, and two unique sailboat sculptures set on stone basesone with a striking dark sail, the other featuring a multicolored design. The objects display natural color and texture variations, adding to their one-of-a-kind aesthetic and appeal. The sturdy selenite sticks can serve both as display pieces or in your mineral collection. The sailboat figures offer artistic value, making them ideal for a desk, shelf, or display cabinet. Each mineral specimen is shown clearly in the images, so you receive exactly what you see. Items show some surface wear and marks, appropriate for pre-owned display minerals. Perfect for enthusiasts, decorators, or anyone seeking unique mineral-based art and collectibles

description:
Rock & Mineral Specimen Collection Lot
Mixed Geological Assortment
Polished Agate, Geodes, Tumbled Stones, Rough Minerals & Educational Kit
This diverse geological collection features a broad variety of natural rock and mineral specimens suitable for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, display, or educational study. The assortment encompasses cut and polished lapidary agates, crystalline geodes, natural rough quartz chunks, tumbled gemstones, and an encased identification rock kit.
Four polished natural agate slice coasters with visible concentric banding and rough edges
Two open crystalline quartz geode halves and one cut polished pink agate slab
Labeled educational rock collection tray containing 15 identified mineral and rock specimens
Large assortment of polished tumbled gemstones including tiger's eye, jasper, aventurine, and amethyst
Large bag of raw mineral chunks including rough rose quartz, clear quartz, and mixed field stones
Wire-wrapped stone pendant and small bagged rainbow moonstone specimen
Condition:
Overall very good condition. Polished agate slices and slabs display clean faces with natural outer rind texture. Geodes feature intact crystalline cavities with no major fractures. Tumbled stones show smooth polished surfaces. Educational kit remains sealed in plastic wrap with some outer plastic wear. Natural inclusions, pitting, and rough edges are inherent to geological specimens.

description:
C. Marsden Huggins
Portrait of an Elder Smoking a Pipe
Art Print on Paper
19" x 23" (Framed)
Signed in print lower left
This evocative portrait by Zimbabwean artist Cleta Marsden-Huggins depicts an African elder cupping his hands around a pipe. Active during the mid-20th century, Marsden-Huggins was celebrated for detailed figurative studies and African wildlife works. This piece showcases the artist's mastery of tonal shading and fine cross-hatching, capturing deep facial character, hands, and draped clothing with striking realistic presence.
Fine monochrome sketch-style print with detailed rendering and expressive texture
Features printed artist signature "C Marsden Huggins" at the lower left
Framed in a black wood frame with off-white mat and ready-to-hang wire on verso
Frame measures approximately 19" wide by 23" high
Condition:
Very good condition overall. The artwork is clean beneath the glass with mild age toning to paper. Frame exhibits minor cosmetic scuffs and edge wear consistent with handling, but remains structurally sound.
